name: Touhou: Food for the Heart
source:
A fusion of a cooking game and a visual novel. The game explores Marisa's journey to understand how she feels about Sakuya.

[From [url=https://megapig9001.itch.io/touhou-food-for-the-heart]Itch.io[/url]]

烹饪游戏和视觉小说的融合。游戏探索了魔理沙了解她对咲夜的感受的旅程。

[来自[url=https://megapig9001.itch.io/touhou-food-for-the-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
